scope: Existing HUG native MANO mesh and original 24 nominal Shadow targets recovered before force-close at initial object state; no new proposal inference, physics rollout, evaluation data, predictor fit, calibration, scale/pose adjustment or source quality selection.
case_selection: Seed 0 of both preexisting observation groups for apple, milk box, mug in inventory source order. Six fixed cases, neither selected nor excluded by geometry or outcome.
query_domain: Deterministic area-weighted triangle centroids after midpoint subdivision of every active object per-geom compiled mesh convex hull until every child area <= density_mm². Density is sqrt(maximum triangle query weight), not a uniform spatial grid or maximum edge guarantee. Actual centered box faces only for cube regression. Query centroid strictly inside another active object hull removed; coincident outward faces assigned to lower geom id. No random surface samples. This approximates exposed collision-union surface, not disabled visual mesh or exact clipped union. Additional union-exterior predicate: source-outward probe q+1e-7m*n must not be strictly inside another object hull (halfspace tolerance 1e-10m). This removes exactly abutting opposite-normal interfaces; no mesh displacement occurs.
query_area: Exact source triangle area divided by 4^subdivision level; sum retained query weights. Report actual min/mean/p95/max weights and child-edge distributions. Interior overlap removal at centroids is density dependent; report discarded and retained area.
native_anatomical_labels: Grouped MANO skinning argmax per vertex; triangle vertex-majority with average grouped weights as deterministic tie breaker. Open per-part triangle subsets for unsigned proximity; no enclosed native finger meshes. Closed whole MANO mesh winding occupancy kept separately.
shadow_geometry: Actual analytic sphere/box/cylinder distances and each compiled mesh geom convex hull, with object collision masks, body exclusions and explicit-pair overrides checked. Carrier labels kept separate. Per-geom union occupancy, not a whole-hand hull or exact interior-depth score.
proximity: Independent per-part unsigned distance <= each fixed diagnostic band. Report native, Shadow, shared, lost native, new Shadow area and IoU. Labels are proxies and geometric regions are not physical contacts.
normals: Only globally exterior queries (outside closed native mesh and every compatible target collider), separated >1e-8 m, near both surfaces in the band. Compare native closest oriented triangle and target nearest analytic/per-geom hull normal only if nearest anatomical labels match. Report different labels and unmatched queries separately; classify closest points inside object collider union.
sanity: Known triangle projection/edges; closed hull vertex-halfspace checks, unit normals, primitive distance checks; numba accelerated exact triangle query versus prior numpy routine; native closed mesh topology/winding checks; original FK object/joint positions reproduce prior report; cube seed-0 legacy 2 mm occupied-or-near baseline must reproduce.
invariants: Guards before scene/model load; time remains zero; initial object qpos and world pose unchanged; original 24 targets preserved; provenance hashes verified before and after; historical artifacts untouched.
limitations: Six existing development cases from one shared MANO shape, not an independent holdout; seed 0 restriction is fixed before metrics.
Decomposed compiled collision hulls may differ from visual object concavity; mug collider union has meaningful concavity but is an approximation.

Centroid overlap exclusion and thresholds produce density-dependent area estimates, not uniform spatial resolution or proven continuum convergence. Skinny facets can have longer edges than density_mm.
Skinning and body-prefix labels and facet normals are anatomical/geometric proxies; native self-intersection may affect winding occupancy.
Unsigned proximity can occur inside the object or hand. Whole-hand occupancy and closest-point inside-object classifications are reported separately.
No physical contact forces, task-outcome sensitivity, original HUG-system equivalence or acceptance gate established.

The collision union can expose narrow decomposition-gap walls absent from the disabled visual mesh. An exposed-union diagnostic remains distinct from the visual object exterior and physical contact area.
amendment_before_any_surface_metrics: Replace maximum-edge midpoint subdivision with deterministic area-density midpoint subdivision to bound runtime on skinny object facets. Original v1 remains preserved and was not executed.
amendment_before_v3_surface_metrics: Preserve v2 in v2/. Remove retained hull queries whose 0.1 micrometer source-outward probe enters another object hull. Geometry-only probe found abutting seam area on milk/mug, zero on apple at tested densities. This fixes phantom interior seam samples without changing saved geometry or grasps.
